name: bugtongph
description: Conversational, gated production pipeline for Filipino video episodes: a Notion-backed bugtong riddle or a model-invented topic, then location, environment, locked character/style/voice profiles, script, a stacked-strip shot-reference sheet image, and copy-ready Google Flow / Veo 3.1 Lite clip prompts.

interface.longDescription: Conversational, checkpoint-safe production pipeline for Filipino video episodes. Each stage offers options, asks one short question, and waits. The subject comes from one of two content pipelines: a riddle selected only from the connected Notion bugtongPH Riddle Database, or a fresh model-invented topic. It then locks location, environment, and one Character + Art Style + Voice profile, writes the script, plans the ingredient-sheet panels, shows a full overview, and only then generates and validates the image before emitting two copy-ready Google Flow / Veo 3.1 Lite prompts. Runs under explicit production, beta, and development channels.
defaultPrompt: .auto - start a bugtong episode. Works with no setup.
.topic - no riddle? Let the AI invent a topic instead.
.riddle bisaya - play in Bisaya instead of Tagalog.
